title: Re-enable Data Classification test (CU 135153 TestDataSensitivities) in CI
summary: Re-enables the Data Sensitivity classification test (CU 135153 TestDataSensitivities) in CI. A temporary allow-list exempts apps that still ship unclassified fields, so new unclassified tables in other apps now fail the test.
key_points: Removes TestDataSensitivities from the disabled-test list so it runs in CI again
Adds GetAppsPendingDataClassification as a temporary allow-list of app ids with unclassified fields
Tables from apps not on the list still fail the test, which catches new regressions
AL-Go settings now trigger a full build when the disabled-test lists change
Small change to codeunit 1765 Projects-Data Classification in the Base Application
